status: design validated for static geometry and sampled single-shot physics; not integrated into game
scope: Ten maps fully redesigned with variable widths and uneven terrain, opponent caves, floating perches, backside/ridge concealment, and teleport flank routes.
units: x and h in tenths of pixels: 1 unit = 10px, and worldWidth is in pixels

rules.tacticalSlope: moving 40+ px may intentionally lead to 5°–35° slopes; changes to aim should be an explicit tactical cost, not unintentional instability
rules.cliff: segments >35° intentionally block walking and need safe alternate paths
rules.late: no initial shot allowed if safe reposition and W01 followup verified
rules.enemyVariety: ridges, trenches, caves, suspended bridge, isolated islands, flight, not just open/roof
rules.width: stage-specific 1100..1960px, camera/AI/turn budgets remain to be tested

limitations: Simulation used geometry, encounters and W01 physics functions, not full campaign engine ticks.
Island/player or enemy spawn support requires compiler and gameplay spawn-anchor extension before implementation.
All sample shot counts are 180 coarse angle/power combinations, not victory probabilities or real-user aiming tolerance.
Teleport follow-up assumes world state unchanged between shots; real enemy counterattacks and ammunition budgets not tested.
Larger map camera, map view, pickups, opponent movement and device performance not tested.
